column1: #   camera/  = reusable OPlus camera-stack series (apply to any crDroid-class A16 tree)
#   device/  = general device-tree improvements (upstreamable toward OnePlus-SM8850-Development / LineageOS)
# Every series is a git format-patch export of <base>..staging/16.0_crdroid of its org repo;
# bases are listed in README.md ("Regen" section). Apply in filename order with git am / git apply.
# Legacy layout patch/<comma-path>/ + los-fix-build-patches/ are NOT mapped here (see README "Legacy").
# crdroid/local_manifest is a reference COPY (manifest xml), not a patch series — intentionally unmapped.
